_meta.description: Performance baselines for vesting-cliff-drip-stream. Update this file via a PR with justification when intentional changes raise metrics.

wasm_instruction_counts._note: Instruction counts measured in Soroban test environment using env.budget().cpu_instruction_count(). Values are upper bounds; actual counts may be lower depending on inputs.

http_response_times._note: Response time baselines for the local Vite dev server measured with autocannon. These apply to frontend HTTP endpoints, not Soroban RPC.

lighthouse._note: Lighthouse score baselines for the frontend. CI fails if any score drops below the threshold.

wasm_size._note: Optimized WASM binary size in bytes. Tracked alongside instruction counts.
